theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A professional, international e-commerce platform needs to establish immense trust and clarity, similar to Amazon Prime but more premium. Swiss High-Contrast provides authority and a function-first layout that handles complex catalogs and administrative tools elegantly.

headings.usage: Use 'Outfit' for all main headings (H1-H4). Apply tracking-tight to H1/H2.

body.usage: Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for paragraphs, product descriptions, and dense admin dashboard data.

dashboard_and_catalog.style: Sharp edges, cardless or max 4px border-radius. Dense and compact.

rules: Use 2-3x more generous spacing in marketing/hero sections.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6).
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a delicate 1px bottom border (border-slate-200).
surfaces_and_micro_themes.product_cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, rounded-lg. On hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.admin_cards: Grid Borders: border-collapse style, sharp edges, no shadows, 1px border. Technical look.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#0043CE] text-white hover:bg-[#002D9C]. Accent buttons (Buy Now): bg-[#FF832B] text-white hover:bg-[#E56814]. No pill-shapes, use rounded-md.

components_strategy.modifications: Override default radii to match brand (rounded-md). Disable default shadows on admin panels to favor grid borders.
components_strategy.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone for marketing, Regular for admin dense views).
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss High-Contrast look. Clear label hierarchy.

image_urls.description: Fashionable minimalist woman with shopping bag. Use for the main hero image or promotional banners.
Premium tech products on a desk. Good for category featured image.
Modern smartphone on dark background. Premium product listing example.
Luxury leather bag. Use for high-end catalog items.
Delivery van for the International Shipping information block.

media.rules: NEVER use placeholder text for logos or images. Always apply proper object-cover and max-height constraints.

motion_and_interactions.hovers: All interactive elements must change state explicitly on hover. e.g. hover:bg-[#002D9C] hover:text-white
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an E-commerce platform with an Admin portal. Language: ES/EN toggle, Currency: COP.
Implement Payment integration with Wompi (mock/setup structure). Auth: JWT.
Catalog requires categories, subcategories, advanced search, and filters.
Admin dashboard requires metrics, product/category CRUD, order management, user management, and coupons.
International shipping logic with configurable rates by country/zone must be present.
DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Outfit.
Follow the High-Contrast Swiss layout: precise, clean, highly functional but visually striking through typography and spacing.
Use Phosphor icons via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react.
